work.scenario: Your manager needs the quarterly sales report by end of day. You also need to confirm a meeting time with a client regarding a new project.
key_phrases: Sila hantarkan laporan jualan suku tahunan.
Saya akan siapkan sebelum petang ini.
Mari kita jadualkan satu mesyuarat dengan pelanggan.

life.scenario: You're planning a weekend trip with friends and need to confirm everyone's availability and preferences for activities. One friend seems unclear about the proposed itinerary for the second day.
key_phrases: Jom kita set meeting untuk bincang trip.
Boleh explain lagi tak pasal aktiviti hari kedua ni?
Thanks for your kerjasama untuk plan trip ni.

tech.scenario: You're collaborating on a shared document with a remote team. You need a colleague to send you the latest version of a design file and clarify a technical specification. You also need to remind them you'll follow up on a bug report from yesterday.
key_phrases: Tolong hantar kat saya fail design yang latest.
Boleh terangkan lagi tak spec teknikal ni?
Saya akan follow up pasal bug report tu.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you formally say 'Please send me the report' in Malay?
quiz_toggle.answer: Sila hantarkan laporan itu kepada saya.
